meanings.usage: 指造成困难或不便的情况
用于停放汽车的建筑物
用于通知或警告的牌子
形容外观不美丽或不吸引人
与介词to/into连用，表示使某物变成另一种状态

meanings.meaning: 戈耳工（希腊神话中的蛇发女妖）
meanings.usage: 特指希腊神话中能将人变成石头的蛇发三姐妹
指相信某事是真的或某人的话语

examples.en: He parked his car outside the shop.
examples.zh: 他把车停在了商店外面。

phrases.usage: 表示与某人某事有麻烦或纠纷

examples.en: She has trouble with her neighbors.

phrases.usage: 表示张贴、建造或竖起某物

examples.en: They put up a tent in the garden.
examples.zh: 他们在花园里搭起了帐篷。

phrases.usage: 表示变成某种状态或事物
表示从那时起一直到现在

examples.en: He has been ill ever since last week.
examples.zh: 从上周起他就一直生病。

phrases.usage: 表示因为、由于（后接名词或代词）

examples.en: Because of the rain, we stayed at home.
examples.zh: 因为下雨，我们待在家里。

examples.en: The medicine had no effect on him.

phrases.phrase: one of + 最高级 + 复数名词

examples.en: This is one of the most beautiful cities in the world.
examples.zh: 这是世界上最美丽的城市之一。

examples.en: I usually return home at six o'clock.

grammar.title: 现在完成时 (Present Perfect Tense)
grammar.structure: 主语 + have/has + 过去分词
grammar.definition: 表示过去发生的行为对现在造成的影响，或从过去开始一直持续到现在的动作 用于描述过去的经验或持续到现在的状态，常与ever since、for、already等连用

examples.en: He has just bought a new house.
He has not been able to get his own car into his garage even once.
examples.zh: 他从未能够把自己的车停进车库。

examples.en: None of them has been turned to stone yet.
examples.zh: 他们中还没有人被变成石头。

grammar.title: 现在完成进行时 (Present Perfect Continuous Tense)
grammar.structure: 主语 + have/has + been + 动词-ing形式
grammar.definition: 表示从过去开始一直持续到现在的动作，可能还在继续 强调动作的持续性，常与ever since、for等时间状语连用

examples.en: He has been having trouble with cars and their owners.
examples.zh: 他一直和汽车及车主有麻烦。

grammar.title: because of 与 because 的区别
grammar.structure: because + 句子 / because of + 名词短语
grammar.definition: because是连词，后接句子；because of是介词短语，后接名词或代词 两者都表示原因，但语法结构不同

examples.en: Because of this, he has not been able to get his car into the garage.
examples.zh: 因为这个原因，他一直没能把车停进车库。

examples.en: He didn't come because he was ill.

patterns.pattern: 主语 + has/have + just + 过去分词

original.en: He has just bought a new house in the city.
original.zh: 他刚在城里买了一栋新房子。

imitations.en: She has just finished her homework.
They have just arrived at the station.

patterns.pattern: 主语 + has/have not been able to + 动词原形

original.en: He has not been able to get his own car into his garage even once.
original.zh: 他从未能够把自己的车停进车库。

imitations.en: She has not been able to sleep well lately.
I have not been able to contact him.

patterns.pattern: It is one of the + 最高级 + 复数名词 + I have ever seen/met

original.en: It is one of the ugliest faces I have ever seen.
original.zh: 这是我见过的最丑陋的脸之一。

imitations.en: This is one of the most interesting books I have ever read.
imitations.zh: 这是我读过的最有趣的书之一。

imitations.en: She is one of the kindest people I have ever met.
imitations.zh: 她是我见过的最善良的人之一。

patterns.pattern: None of + 复数名词 + has/have + 过去分词 + yet

original.en: But none of them has been turned to stone yet!
original.zh: 但他们中还没有人被变成石头！

imitations.en: None of the students has finished the exam yet.
imitations.zh: 还没有一个学生完成考试。

imitations.en: None of the letters has been replied to yet.

lines.en: Jasper White is one of those rare people who believes in ancient myths .
lines.zh: 贾斯珀。怀特是少有的相信古代神话的人之一。

lines.en: he has just bought a new house in the city, but ever since he moved in, he has had trouble with cars and their owners.
lines.zh: 他刚在城里买下一所新房子，但自从搬进去后，就和汽车及车主们发生了磨擦。

lines.en: When he returns home at night, he always finds that someone has parked a car outside his gate.
lines.zh: 当他夜里回到家时，总是发现有人把车停在他家大门外。

lines.en: Because of this, he has not been able to get his own car into his garage even once.
lines.zh: 为此，他甚至一次也没能把自己的车开进车库。

lines.en: Jasper has put up 'No Parking' signs outside his gate, but these have not had any effect.
lines.zh: 贾斯珀曾把几块“禁止停车”的牌子挂在大门外边，但没有任何效果。

lines.en: Now he has put an ugly stone head over the gate.
lines.zh: 现在他把一个丑陋的石雕头像放在了大门上边，这是我见过的最丑陋的头像之一。

lines.en: It is one of the ugliest faces I have ever seen.
I asked him what it was and he told me that it was Medusa, the Gorgon .
lines.zh: 他告诉我那是蛇发女怪美杜莎。

lines.en: jasper hopes that she will turn cars and their owners to stone.
lines.zh: 贾斯珀希望她把汽车和车主们都变成石头。

lines.en: But none of them has been turned to stone yet!
lines.zh: 但到目前为止还没有一个变成石头呢！

questions.zh: 贾斯珀·怀特遇到了什么麻烦？
questions.a: He has trouble with cars and their owners: someone always parks a car outside his gate, so he has not been able to get his own car into his garage even once.
questions.aZh: 汽车和车主总给他添麻烦：总有人把车停在他家大门外，他甚至一次也没能把自己的车开进车库。

questions.q: Why have Jasper's 'No Parking' signs failed?
questions.zh: 为什么贾斯珀挂起的“禁止停车”牌子没有用？
questions.a: Because these signs have not had any effect on the drivers.
questions.aZh: 因为这些牌子对车主毫无效果。
questions.hint: 第 6 句：but these have not had any effect。

questions.q: What has Jasper put over his gate, and who is it?
questions.zh: 贾斯珀在大门上方放了什么？那是谁？
questions.a: He has put an ugly stone head over the gate, and it is Medusa, the Gorgon.
questions.aZh: 他在大门上方放了一个丑陋的石雕头像，那是蛇发女怪美杜莎。

questions.q: Why does the text say 'he has had trouble' rather than 'he had trouble'?
questions.zh: 为什么课文用现在完成时 has had trouble，而不用一般过去时 had trouble？
questions.a: Because the trouble began when he moved in and still continues now; 'ever since' joins a past point to the present, so the main clause takes the present perfect.
questions.aZh: 因为麻烦从他搬进去那刻开始，一直持续到现在；ever since 把过去的时间点和现在连起来，主句要用现在完成时。
questions.hint: 第 3 句：ever since he moved in, he has had trouble。

questions.q: The text ends with 'But none of them has been turned to stone yet!' What does this ending tell us about Jasper's belief in ancient myths?
questions.zh: 课文以“但到目前为止还没有一个变成石头呢！”结尾，这个结尾透露出作者对贾斯珀信奉神话的态度是什么？
questions.a: It shows the writer's gentle humour: Jasper really believes in the ancient myth, but Medusa's power exists only in the myth, so not one car or owner has turned to stone.
questions.aZh: 这是作者善意的幽默：贾斯珀真心相信神话，但美杜莎的法力只存在于神话之中，一辆车、一个车主也没变成石头。
questions.hint: 把末句与首句 believes in ancient myths 对照。

translation:
贾斯珀。
怀特是少有的相信古代神话的人之一。
他刚在城里买下一所新房子，但自从搬进去后，就和汽车及车主们发生了磨擦。
当他夜里回到家时，总是发现有人把车停在他家大门外。
为此，他甚至一次也没能把自己的车开进车库。
贾斯珀曾把几块“禁止停车”的牌子挂在大门外边，但没有任何效果。
现在他把一个丑陋的石雕头像放在了大门上边，这是我见过的最丑陋的头像之一。
我问他那是什么？
他告诉我那是蛇发女怪美杜莎。
贾斯珀希望她把汽车和车主们都变成石头。
但到目前为止还没有一个变成石头呢！
title: No Parking
subtitle: 禁止停车

lead.question: 信奉古代神话的贾斯珀，搬进城里新房后为何麻烦不断？
lead.warmup: No Parking 是最常见的禁令牌，可贾斯珀家门前的牌子却毫无用处。他是少有的相信古代神话的人，搬进城里新居后，总有人把车停在他家大门外，害得他一次也没能把车开进车库。于是他把丑陋的石雕头像——蛇发女怪美杜莎——挂到了大门上方。读前不妨猜一猜：神话真能管住乱停车的人吗？
goals: 听懂课文，能用英文回答 Jasper White 的问题出在哪里
掌握 ever since 引导的现在完成时与一般过去时的分工
辨析 believe in / believe、because of / because、can / be able to 的用法
运用 put up、have trouble with、turn ... to stone、effect 等本课词组
lead.summary: 本课讲贾斯珀·怀特信奉古代神话：搬入新居后屡遭乱停车之扰，禁令牌毫无效果，便在门上摆出美杜莎的石雕头像，指望把汽车和车主变成石头，结果一个也没变。语法重点是现在完成时与一般过去时的配合（ever since 从句用过去时、主句用完成时），以及 one of + 复数名词 后定语从句谓语用单数。
lead.tips: 易错提醒：one of those rare people 后的定语从句谓语要用单数 believes；because of 只接名词或代词，接句子必须用 because。

exercises.q: 用所给词的适当形式填空：Jasper White is one of those rare people who ____ (believe) in ancient myths.
exercises.note: one of + 复数名词，从句谓语用单数。

exercises.q: 选词填空：____ this, he has not been able to get his own car into his garage even once.（because / because of）
exercises.note: 后接代词 this，须用介词短语。

exercises.q: 用动词的适当时态填空：Ever since he ____ (move) in, he ____ (have) trouble with cars and their owners.
exercises.note: ever since 从句用过去时，主句用完成时。

exercises.q: 根据汉语补全句子：贾斯珀曾在大门外挂起几块“禁止停车”的牌子。Jasper has ____ ____ 'No Parking' signs outside his gate.
exercises.note: put up 此处意为挂起、竖起。

exercises.q: 汉译英：贾斯珀希望她把汽车和车主们都变成石头。
exercises.a: Jasper hopes that she will turn cars and their owners to stone.
exercises.note: turn ... to/into stone 把……变成石头。

exercises.q: 选词填空：He has not ____ ____ ____ get his own car into his garage even once.（can / be able to）
exercises.note: 完成时中表示能力用 be able to。

exercises.q: 仿写句子：这是我所见过的最丑陋的头像之一。
exercises.a: It is one of the ugliest faces I have ever seen.
exercises.note: one of + 最高级 + 复数名词。

quiz.q: 课文中 one of those rare people 的 rare 是什么意思？
quiz.note: rare 意为罕见的、少有的。

quiz.q: 贾斯珀相信古代神话，课文用了哪个表达？
quiz.note: believe in 表示相信……的存在/价值。

quiz.q: Jasper has put up 'No Parking' signs outside his gate. 句中 put up 的含义是？
quiz.note: put up 在文中指挂起、竖起。

quiz.q: Ever since he moved in, he ____ trouble with cars and their owners.
quiz.note: ever since 主句用现在完成时。

quiz.q: He has not ____ get his own car into his garage even once.
quiz.note: 完成时里表能力只用 be able to。

quiz.q: Jasper hopes that she will turn cars and their owners to stone. 短语 turn ... to stone 的意思是？
options: put the stone on the car
quiz.note: turn ... to/into stone 把……变成石头。
